title: The EBA follow-up review confirms high level of supervisory convergence in applying default rules across the EU/EEA
summary: The European Banking Authority (EBA) today published a follow-up report on the application of its Guidelines on the definition of default (DoD), confirming strong implementation across all reviewed EU/EEA jurisdictions and a high degree of supervisory convergence in the application of the framework.
author: Jana Jaklic

title: ​EBA publishes hotfix for the reporting framework v4.4 - Phase 1
summary: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) has issued a hotfix for its Reporting Framework version 4.4 - Phase 1, addressing technical issues identified following the release of the final technical package.
author: Jana Jaklic

title: EBA supports further progress on the Banking Union, including on deposit insurance
summary: The EBA supports further progress on the Banking Union, including on deposit insurance, as a key step towards a more efficient and resilient European banking system.
